records.text: An anonymous hospital source alleged that during the 10 a.m. hour on September 10, more than two hours before Charlie Kirk was shot, Timpanogos Regional Hospital staff directed everyone in the emergency room to another wing.
records.speaker: Anonymous Timpanogos Hospital source (Ep iB-YtO3UZOg)

appearances.snippet: I am told that at some point in the 10 o'clock a.m. hour. ... On September 10th, so to be clear, and this is crucial, over two hours before Charlie was shot, the Timpanogos hospital staff directed everyone who was in the emergency room into a different wing of the hospital.

verification.notes: Owens attributed the claim to an unnamed source. No patient, staff member, transfer log, contemporaneous notice, or hospital record was made public, and current searches found no independent corroboration of a pre-shooting emergency-room relocation. The claim remains attempted/unverifiable.

records.text: An anonymous hospital source alleged that at approximately 11:30 a.m. the emergency-room patients were told they would be shuttled to Utah Valley Hospital.
records.speaker: Anonymous Timpanogos Hospital source (Ep iB-YtO3UZOg)

appearances.snippet: Then after some time at approximately 11 30 a.m. patients were informed that they would be transferred aboard shuttles to Intermountain Hospital. ... That's Utah Valley Hospital. And that's what happened.

verification.notes: The episode attributes the shuttle-transfer claim to an anonymous hospital source. No transfer manifest, shuttle record, patient testimony, hospital notice, or independent report was located. Absence from public sources is not proof the transfer did not occur, so the result is unverifiable rather than false.

records.text: An anonymous hospital source reported that Charlie Kirk had a file at Utah Valley Hospital and employees there were specifically instructed not to touch or open it.
records.speaker: Anonymous Timpanogos Hospital source (Ep iB-YtO3UZOg)

appearances.snippet: A story which we broke way back in October of last year on October 28th, to be specific, we couldn't figure out why, but we were like, Charlie has a hospital file that was at Utah Valley Hospital. ... We were so confused by this. Somebody had leaked this to us. People who worked there were certain that he was being treated at Utah Valley and at Intermountain because not only did he have a file there, but they were specifically instructing people. ... For example, not to touch or open that file. Do you remember that? I'm going to show you that file again. October 28th, we did this episode.

verification.notes: The existence and handling of a Charlie Kirk chart at Utah Valley Hospital is attributed only to an anonymous source. No authenticated screenshot, audit log, hospital statement, court exhibit, or named employee corroboration was located. Medical privacy restrictions also prevent independent public confirmation, so the claim is attempted/unverifiable.
